subject: Curai x Encord - data & model eval
text:
Hi [NAME],

By way of intro I lead AI/ML partnerships at Encord. We work with
healthcare AI teams from Mayo Clinic and Iterative Health on the data
curation, annotation, and model eval infrastructure.

Wanted to reach out as I saw your role leading platform engineering -
building the infra that needs to be fast, scalable, and accurate for both
clinicians and patients is a meaningful problem to solve.

Teams use us to manage training data pipeline and post-training deployment,
tasks spanning across auto-labeling, HITL QA, and tracking where models
drift and underperform.

Feel like there's real overlap with what you're building at Curai. Would
you be open to a quick intro?

subject: ultrasound data pipeline
text:
Hi [NAME],

      I wanted to reach out because we've helped a few teams that outgrew Label Studio move to a platform built for more complex, multimodal data workflows.

      viz.ai and Floy optimize complex ontology, model assisted pre-labeling, scalable QA, and standardized ingestion/export pipelines. 

      If this is on your roadmap for [YEAR], I'd love a chance to share how Encord can help.

subject: Label Studio + Snorkel -> where teams usually hit the wall
text:
Hi [NAME], 

      Noticed you're running data labeling and model validation across Label Studio and Snorkel for 
      [COMPANY]'s GenAI workflows - curious how that stack's been holding up as things scale. 

      A pattern we see with similar teams: QA gets fragmented, multimodal use cases stretch the tooling, and workflows become code-heavy to maintain. That's usually when teams start consolidating tools and switch to Encord. 

      We support Onfido/Entrust, Veriff, and VIDA on unifying curation, annotation, QA, and model eval across modalities (docs, image, video, audio) - with tighter auditability for regulated environments.

      Worth a 20-min chat next week to show you what that looks like in practice?

subject: identity graph liability
text:
Hi 
         [NAME], 

         Congrats on the Bolt partnership - scaling [COMPANY]'s ID graph and RiskOS signals across a network is a huge milestone! 

         When IDV systems expand to multiple merchants and massive volumes, the challenge isn't signal generation - it's tracking and auditing edge cases, false positives, and model decisions across the ecosystem, and feeding those insights back into the next iteration. 

         We work with IDV teams to make data review, labeling, and model eval systematic and auditable, so reliability and trust scale alongside deployment. 

          If useful, I'd love to grab 20 mins to compare notes on how you're thinking about maintaining model quality and governance as you roll out more partnerships.

text:
